label: early-episode D2 unit (first ~20 trials), stronger when S2 is reached or after no reward
explanation: Fires almost only at D2 (98.5% of mass; never at D1, a trace at GO). It is confined to early episode: rate about 22% of steps in trials 0-9, 10% in 10-19, 3% in 20-29, essentially zero after trial 40, and it decays with time since a reversal too. Within that window it prefers D2 steps showing S2 (80% of mass, lift 4.3x vs 1.4x for S1) and trials whose previous trial was unrewarded (lift 1.5x). It is highest when the value output is high. It never fires when the reward input is 1. Phase plus episode trial alone, (phase==D2)&(ep_trial<20), gives F1 0.56 / mass recall 0.87. Adding S2-or-previous-unrewarded raises F1 to 0.66 (dev) / mass recall 0.84. It is not explained by the choice, transition, or future reward (all flat). Precision stays modest: many early D2 steps showing S2 stay silent, so magnitude probably carries a decaying early-episode / uncertainty signal. Only observed variables are used.
